text:
Maria Gomez: Quick thread — proposal to move provisional attribution into a lightweight sidecar on the edge routers to reduce request-path latency and emit a 'provisional' metering event.
Akshay Patel: By provisional you mean we emit an early fingerprint + token estimate before the final ledger write arrives?
Maria Gomez: Yup. Sidecar emits {provenance_id, request_id, tenant_id, model, tokens_estimate, provisional:true}. Reconciler later consumes final billing/audit stream and finalizes the record.
Timothy Chen: Main concerns: duplicates and out-of-order finalization. How do we make reconciliation idempotent and safe for retries?
Maria Gomez: Plan: provenance_id = sha256(tenant_id|request_id|fingerprint). Deterministic id so retries/upserts collapse. Provisional events kept in a short local store+Kafka topic; reconciler upserts final state.
Jules (ingest-bot): deploy preview: metering-sidecar v0.1 deployed to staging (sha: abc123) :rocket:
Akshay Patel: Deterministic id helps. Need to ensure fingerprint stability across retry paths (router vs client retry). If fingerprint can differ we get duplicates.
Priya Rao: Observability requests: add metric provisional_to_final_lag (histogram) and counters provisional_emitted / provisional_orphaned. Also tag by model and tenant.
Timothy Chen: Perf: sidecar must be non-blocking. Do not sync to network on critical path. Local append to a file or memory buffer and background publish to Kafka.
Maria Gomez: Agreed. Tradeoffs: extra local state + failure modes. We'll set TTL for provisional entries (48h) to guard against never-seen finals and run reconcile sweeps.
Akshay Patel: Edge-case: final audit never arrives. Options: auto-close after TTL, or mark orphaned and emit an anomaly alert for ops. I lean to auto-close then create a 'late-adjustment' path.
Maria Gomez: Proposal: orphaned -> mark state=orphaned, create a ticket event in audit stream; after 30d auto-close with reason=auto_orphan_expire and emit a negative adjustment if needed.
Timothy Chen: Locking model: don't add distributed locks. Rely on provenance_id idempotency + last_write_wins using tuple (final_ts, source_priority) where final wins.
Priya Rao: Add dashboards: provisional count over time, provisional->final ratio, avg lag, top tenants with orphan rate. Alert when orphan_rate > 0.5% over 24h.
Jules (ingest-bot): noted. I'll open GH issue: "sidecar provisional attribution -> reconciler checklist" and attach perf SLOs + staging runbook.
Maria Gomez: Next steps: write short RFC with sequence diagram, sample event JSON, TTL choices (48h/30d), and run a 2-week staging experiment limited to 10% of edge traffic.
Akshay Patel: Sounds good. I'll review the RFC and add fingerprint stability tests.
Timothy Chen: Add a load test for the reconciler: simulate high out-of-order finals and duplicate provisional streams.
Maria Gomez: Thanks all — will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
